title: fix(ai-mistral): preserve length for tool calls cut at the token limit

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@tanstack/ai-mistral': patch
+---
+
+A Mistral chat stream that hits the token limit during a tool call reports `finishReason: 'length'`. Complete arguments are normalized onto `input`. Incomplete arguments keep the raw `args` and omit `input`, and the stream does not throw. A `tool_calls` finish with malformed arguments still throws.

+When a tool call hits the token limit, `metadata.tanstack.finishReason` is `length`.
+Complete JSON arguments include a normalized `input` on `TOOL_CALL_END`.
+Incomplete arguments keep the raw `args` and have no `input`.

+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { chat, createChatOptions, toolDefinition } from '@tanstack/ai'
+import { createMistralText } from '@tanstack/ai-mistral'
+import { z } from 'zod'
+
+const LLMOCK_DEFAULT_BASE = process.env.LLMOCK_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4010'
+const DUMMY_KEY = 'sk-e2e-test-dummy-key'
+
+/**
+ * The first model call answers with one tool call and finishes with
+ * `length` (the fixture in `fixtures/truncated-tool-call` sets
+ * `finishReason: 'length'`). Mistral must keep `length` on `RUN_FINISHED`
+ * instead of mapping it to `tool_calls`. The cut call never runs. aimock
+ * sends complete JSON arguments, so the partial-JSON path is covered in
+ * `packages/ai-mistral/tests/mistral-adapter.test.ts`.
+ */
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/mistral-truncated-tool-call')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      POST: async () => {
+        const adapter = createMistralText('mistral-large-latest', DUMMY_KEY, {
+          baseURL: LLMOCK_DEFAULT_BASE,
+        })
+        let runs = 0
+        const lookupWeather = toolDefinition({
+          name: 'lookup_weather',
+          description: 'Look up the weather.',
+          inputSchema: z.object({ location: z.string() }),
+        }).server(async () => {
+          runs += 1
+          return 'sunny'
+        })
+
+        let text = ''
+        const toolResults: Array<unknown> = []
+        const finishReasons: Array<string | undefined> = []
+        let runError: string | undefined
+        try {
+          for await (const chunk of chat({
+            threadId: 'mistral-truncated-tool-call',
+            ...createChatOptions({ adapter }),
+            tools: [lookupWeather],
+            messages: [
+              {
+                role: 'user',
+                content: '[truncated-tool-call] weather in Paris',
+              },
+            ],
+          })) {
+            if (chunk.type === 'TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT') text += chunk.delta
+            if (chunk.type === 'TOOL_CALL_RESULT') {
+              toolResults.push(chunk.content)
+            }
+            if (chunk.type === 'RUN_FINISHED') {
+              const tanstack = chunk.metadata?.tanstack
+              finishReasons.push(
+                tanstack &&
+                  typeof tanstack === 'object' &&
+                  'finishReason' in tanstack &&
+                  typeof tanstack.finishReason === 'string'
+                  ? tanstack.finishReason
+                  : undefined,
+              )
+            }
+            if (chunk.type === 'RUN_ERROR') runError = chunk.message
+          }
+          if (runError !== undefined) throw new Error(runError)
+          return Response.json({
+            ok: true,
+            runs,
+            toolResults,
+            text,
+            finishReasons,
+          })
+        } catch (error) {
+          return Response.json({
+            ok: false,
+            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+          })
+        }
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})

+import { test, expect } from './fixtures'
+
+const DEFAULT_TEXT =
+  'The answer stopped at the output limit, so no tool call in it ran. Send the tool calls again. Do not repeat text you already wrote. If one call has a large input, split the work into smaller calls.'
+
+type Result = {
+  ok: boolean
+  error?: string
+  runs?: number
+  toolResults?: Array<string>
+  text?: string
+  finishReasons?: Array<string | undefined>
+}
+
+// The route and its aimock fixture are described at
+// `src/routes/api.mistral-truncated-tool-call.ts`.
+test.describe('mistral — tool call cut at the output limit', () => {
+  test('the cut call does not run and the run ends with length, not tool_calls', async ({
+    request,
+  }) => {
+    const res = await request.post('/api/mistral-truncated-tool-call')
+    expect(res.ok()).toBe(true)
+
+    const { ok, error, runs, toolResults, text, finishReasons } =
+      (await res.json()) as Result
+
+    expect(error ?? null).toBeNull()
+    expect(ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(runs).toBe(0)
+    expect(toolResults).toEqual([DEFAULT_TEXT])
+    expect(text).toBe('')
+    expect(finishReasons).toEqual(['length'])
+  })
+})
